name: gameshelf
description: GameShelf is a web application born from my love of video games and  my desire for a better way to keep track of the titles I own and play.  The application's primary goal is to help gamers who use multiple platforms—such as  Xbox, PlayStation, PC, or Nintendo—organize their games in one place.  Instead of having to remember which games they own on each platform,  users can create a personal library to add their games and their experiences with each one.
